title: Fluffy Soft Diaper Pants New Born

details.description:
Introducing Little's Premium Fluffy Soft Baby Diaper Pants NB (New Born), the ultimate combination of softness, comfort, and protection for your baby. These pant-style pull-up diapers help in quick absorption and come with perfect fitment to help keep your baby active during the daytime. Their up to 12 hours of absorption protection ensures long-lasting dryness to help your baby have uninterrupted sleep during the night.
Features:
Up to 12 Hours Absorption Protection - Little's Fluffy Soft Baby Diaper Pants offer up to 12 hours of absorption protection to ensure playful days & uninterrupted sleep for your baby. Its ADL technology ensures equal distribution of liquid, avoiding heaviness and ensuring maximum comfort for your baby.
Anti-Rash Formula - Little's Fluffy Soft Baby Diaper Pants are powered with an anti-rash formula, which keeps your baby rash-free.
Wetness Indicator - Little's Fluffy Soft Baby Diaper Pants have a wetness indicator, which turns from yellow to blue, indicating it is time to change your baby's diaper to ensure maximum comfort.
Fluffy Soft Belt, Fluffy Soft Layers & Breathable Material - Little's Diaper has a fluffy soft waistband, which ensures no waist marks or redness. It has fluffy soft layers and breathable material to provide ultimate comfort for your baby.
No Nasties - Little's Diapers are free from parabens, phthalates, and alcohol, making them suitable for your baby's sensitive skin.
Odour Lock & Imported Materials - Little's Fluffy Soft Baby Diaper Pants are made from imported materials powered by absorbents, including Superabsorbent Polymer & Fluff Pulp. It also locks the smell from the diaper, making your baby feel fresh. This ensures a safe & gentle experience for your little one every day!
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place.

Little’s AirSense Ultra-Premium Baby Diaper Pants are designed with highly breathable material featuring 50 million breathable pores and are enriched with shea butter for added care. Dermatologically tested, they are suitable for a baby’s delicate skin. Bubble Layer Technology creates a soft barrier between the skin and the wet core, helping keep the skin dry and comfortable.

details.description:
Give your baby's delicate skin the purest care with Little's AquaSense Baby Wipes, formulated with 99.9% RO purified water. It is basically water! Made from 100% viscose plant-based biodegradable fabric, these wipes are luxuriously thick, incredibly strong, and won't tear. They softly cleanse baby's hands, face, and diaper area, helping prevent rashes or irritation. Hypoallergenic and dermatologically tested. Unscented and free from alcohol and parabens, they are suitable for babies as well as adults for hygienic cleansing anytime, anywhere.
Features:
99.9% Pure RO Water - Formulated with 99.9% RO purified water as the primary ingredient. Free from unnecessary chemicals, fragrances, and additives. It's basically water!
100% Viscose Plant-Based Fabric - Made from 100% viscose plant-based biodegradable fabric that is luxuriously thick, incredibly strong, and won't tear, even during the messiest clean-ups. Softly cleanses baby's hands, face, and diaper area, helping prevent rashes or irritation.
100% Biodegradable - Eco-conscious plant-based fabric that is fully biodegradable, a responsible choice for everyday baby care.
Enriched with Aloe Vera - Infused with soothing Aloe Vera extract to keep baby's skin soft, soothed, and naturally moisturised after every wipe.
Hypoallergenic & Dermatologically Tested - Proven to be exceptionally gentle and safe for the most sensitive and delicate newborn skin. pH balanced and clinically tested from birth.
Free from Harmful Chemicals - Consciously formulated without alcohol, parabens, and other harsh chemicals. Safe for everyday use on baby's delicate skin.
Secure Plastic Lid Seal - Each pack features a reliable plastic lid seal that locks in moisture perfectly, ensuring every last wipe stays fresh, wet, and free from germs, and ready to use.
Unscented - Fragrance-free formula ideal for newborns and babies with reactive or sensitive skin. Suitable for babies as well as adults.
details.usageInstructions:
Open the Lid & peel back the sealing sticker partially.
Pull wipes to use as required.
Reseal the sealing sticker & close the lid after every use to prevent the wipes from dust & drying out.

details.description:
Little's Soft Cleansing Baby Wipes are long, extra thick, and extra moist, specially designed for your baby's gentle and delicate skin. Made with a 50:50 blend of polyester and viscose, a better alternative to cotton, which helps retain moisture for longer and prevents tearing while wiping. Enriched with the goodness of Aloe Vera, Jojoba Oil, and Vitamin E, they ensure that your baby's skin remains soft and moisturised, while the gentle fragrance keeps your baby fresh and happy all day without causing any irritation. Alcohol-free, paraben-free, dermatologically safe, hypoallergenic, and pH balanced.
Features:
Extra Thick & Extra Moist - Long, extra thick, and extra moist wipes, ideal for diaper changes and for cleaning your baby's face and hands.
50:50 Polyester & Viscose Blend - A better alternative to cotton that retains moisture for a longer time and prevents tearing while wiping, ensuring effective and gentle cleaning every time.
Aloe Vera - Cleanses and moisturises your baby's skin, keeping it soft and healthy with every use.
Jojoba Oil - Nourishes baby's skin with essential conditioning, and with Aloe Vera & Vitamin E, it enables better nourishment for your baby's delicate skin.
Vitamin E - Offers antioxidant protection for healthy and well-nourished baby skin.
Gentle Fragrance - Freshens up your baby's senses and keeps your baby happy all day without causing any irritation.
Alcohol-Free & Paraben-Free - Goes through rigorous quality checks. Dermatologically safe with hypoallergenic, pH balanced ingredients, ensuring better safety for your baby.
Ideal for Multiple Use - For gently cleansing and moisturising your baby's delicate skin during diaper changes or cleaning your baby's face and hands during mealtimes, playtime, and while travelling.
details.usageInstructions:
Open the sealing sticker.
Pull out the wipe and clean.
Close the sealing sticker.
Safety Warning:
Avoid direct contact with eyes.
Keep wipes away from children to prevent chewing or swallowing.
Adult supervision is recommended during use.
Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight or high temperatures to prevent the drying of wipes.
